findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body: When document IDs are known or overlap between tenants, `getDocument` still receives tenant context but `loadDocument` now queries only by `documentId`. This permits returning another tenant’s document. Preserve `ctx.tenantId` in the call and database filter.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body:
`getDocument` still receives tenant context, but the query now filters only by `documentId`. If IDs overlap across tenants—or a tenant requests another tenant’s known ID—the database can return cross-tenant data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported cache-reading module
findings.body:
Deleting `src/cache.ts` removes the exported `readCached` API. Existing consumers or tests importing this module will fail module resolution/compilation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body:
In a shared multi-tenant database, any caller who supplies another tenant’s document ID can retrieve that document because the query no longer includes `ctx.tenantId`. This is a direct cross-tenant authorization bypass and data disclosure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
